name: Polyp Spitter

Polyp Spitter: a squat lump of polyps on stubby root-legs, a ring of open tube mouths on top glowing magenta; pink-violet with white tips. Charming strange compact living coral colony, rounded mound of pink and violet fleshy polyps, exactly four short sturdy rootlike legs beneath, ring of six upright open tube mouths across its crown, white chalky tube rims with restrained magenta luminous interiors. No human face, eyes or added accessories. Front-facing neutral pose, rear legs peeking beside front legs, clear silhouette; eye-level camera, tubes naturally flare enough to reveal mouths without overhead camera. Warm detailed painted game art, tactile coral texture, soft shading and readable forms. Entire body, tube tips and feet inside square transparent canvas with broad empty margins. No water, rocks, ground, cast shadow, haze, text, particles or extra creatures.
